summary: Quenverell's 2018 capability deck in the legacy template (v3). Slide 4 'Bioinformatics in drug discovery' explains how expression data, genetics and pathway analysis support target selection and biomarker work; later slides cover RNA-seq services, data acceptance, docking support, engagement types and a short case study.

slides.title: About Quenverell
bullets: Founded in Edinburgh in 2009 by computational biologists
Part of the Vellacombe group of laboratories since 2014
Fourteen scientists across bioinformatics, computational chemistry and data management
We work as an extension of the client's project team

slides.title: What clients ask us for
bullets: Which target should we build an assay for?
Is this target expressed where the disease is?
What did our compound actually do to the cells?
Which patients should go into the first study?
slides.notes: Open with the questions, not the methods.

bullets: Analyses public and client data to support decisions from target to clinic

Mode of action from compound-treated expression profiles

bullets: Reproducible pipelines and documented data acceptance
